newsitem.title: ROMANIA: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 4 PM.
newsitem.headline: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 4 PM.

text.p: * The Upper Senate elected its standing board in the afternoon. Its deputy chairmen will be: Oliviu Gherman of the party of Social Democracy (PDSR), Radu Vasile of the National Peasant Party (PNT-CD), Mircea Ionescu-Quintus of the National Liberal Party (PNL) and Cristian Dumitrescu of the Social Democratic Union (USD).
The Senate will resume its sessions on Monday to discuss the composition of parliament's standing commissions.

* The newly-appointed deputy chairmen of the lower Chamber of Deputies are: Vasile Lupu of PNT-CD, Radu Berceanu of the USD and Andrei Chiriman of the PNL. A fourth such position remained vacant after the opposition declined to nominate a candidate.

The opposition -- currently made of the PDSR, the Greater Romania Party and the National Unity Party -- has refused to vote and left the parliament hall in a protest against the distribution of positions in the chamber's leading board.
* President-elect Emil Constantinescu will be sworn in before both parliament chambers on Friday.

* Constantinescu met outgoing President Ion Iliescu in the Cotroceni Palace in an informal meeting to discuss routine activities in the presidential office and the president's agenda in the coming weeks.
* Constantinescu received congratulatory messages from the Iranian and Brazilian presidents.

* German Chancellor Helmuth Kohl sent a message to President Iliescu expressing gratitude for his efforts to boost German-Romanian relations and to bring Romania closer to the European Union and NATO. -- Bucharest Newsroom 40-1 3120264
